INSERT INTO coupon ( id, code, discount_type, discount_value, min_order, max_discount, expires_at, active ) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), 'WELCOME10', 'PERCENT', 10, 0, NULL, NULL, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon WHERE UPPER(code) = 'WELCOME10');
UPDATE coupon SET discount_type = 'PERCENT', discount_value = 10, min_order = 0, active = true WHERE UPPER(code) = 'WELCOME10';
